page.overview:
Who is Phil Hill?

Philip Toll "Phil" Hill Jr. (born April 20, 1927 in Miami, Florida – died August 28, 2008 in Salinas, California) was a United States driver who drove in Formula One in the 1950s and 1960s and is the only US-born driver to win the World Championship, which he did in . Mario Andretti is the only other US Champion, but he was born in what was then Italy.
